description: Native connector ruled-loft section profiles, measured from the purchased STL. Decoration-free mechanical regions only; no source mesh is read by the model.

measurement.section_parameter: equal parameter intervals between all crossings of a common feature Y plane; normalized arclength inside each interval

removed_transverse_alignment_groove.method: join measured lower closed-end dovetail contours across the transverse notch without changing their mating outline

section_reduction.method: Recursive station selection evaluated at every original height and the union of all contour knots. Piecewise-linear interpolation makes the pointwise XY displacement bound apply between these samples as well.
section_reduction.preservation: Surviving section points and landmark parameters are unchanged. First and last two stations and detent shoulder stations are mandatory.
